combine_scene_fields: combine multiple SceneFieldData arrays into a new scene with a shared mapping using scenetools.combine_fields
filter_scene_fields_bitarray: filter a scene to keep only specific fields by passing a BitArray mask to scenetools.filter_fields
filter_only_scene_fields: filter a scene to keep only explicitly listed SceneField types using scenetools.filter_only_fields
filter_except_scene_fields: filter a scene to exclude specified SceneField types using scenetools.filter_except_fields
get_absolute_3d_transformations: get absolute 3D transformation matrices for a scene field using scenetools.absolute_field_transformations3d
